overview:
**Fire danger in the Montrose (High Elevation) area is Moderate today, with dry fuels outweighing scattered afternoon storms.**
- Danger holds at Moderate all week, but ERC climbs steadily from 53% today to 66% by Sept 24 as fuels continue drying.
- Winds stay light (5–12 mph), shifting from ENE to NE, while afternoon humidity drops sharply by Sunday-Monday.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted, and none of the 7 local watchout thresholds are met today.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in force on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands covering Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta counties and a portion of Gunnison County, while the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests have removed all fire restrictions.
- The Elk Fire 7 miles northwest of Lake City (Hinsdale County) is 73% contained at 7,257 acres with no new fire behavior reported.
- Scattered thunder
